description.en: Adaptive dimension reduction for overlapping group sparsity. Code and experiments for sparse optimization, from LASSO to overlapping group LASSO.
description.zh: 面向重叠组稀疏问题的自适应降维方法，包含从 LASSO 到重叠组 LASSO 的稀疏优化算法与实验代码。

description.en: Machine-checked convergence of Krasnosel’skiĭ–Mann and Halpern iterations, with reusable components for analysis in Hilbert spaces.
description.zh: Krasnosel’skiĭ–Mann 迭代与 Halpern 迭代的机器可检验收敛性证明，以及 Hilbert 空间分析的可复用组件。
